stories.title: Senate Democrats block bill to limit lawmakers' stock trades

en.title: Senate Democrats block bill to limit lawmakers' stock trades
en.summary: Senate Democrats rejected a Republican-backed measure on restricting legislators' stock trading that had passed the House, citing insufficient restrictions and opposing a voter identification component.

stories.title: Why Senate Democrats blocked a bill to limit lawmakers' stock trades

en.title: Why Senate Democrats blocked a bill to limit lawmakers' stock trades
en.summary: Senate Democrats blocked legislation that would have prevented lawmakers and their relatives from trading publicly-listed stocks, citing disagreement over an attached provision concerning voter identification requirements.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows Christa Pike's execution

en.title: Supreme Court allows Christa Pike's execution
en.summary: The Supreme Court upheld the ability to proceed with Tennessee's execution of Christa Pike, who would become the first woman executed in the state in two centuries.

stories.title: District attorney in Cornell case claims he never saw police transcript with alleged rape victim

en.title: District attorney in Cornell case claims he never saw police transcript with alleged rape victim
en.summary: The prosecutor handling an alleged rape case at Cornell University states he did not receive a transcript of the accuser's discussion with campus police regarding her assault allegations.

stories.title: What New York’s Rape Laws Mean for the Cornell Case

en.title: What New York's Rape Laws Mean for the Cornell Case
en.summary: New York law creates prosecution challenges when alleged victims consumed alcohol voluntarily, a factor the Cornell case prosecutor cited as affecting decisions to charge accused students with sexual assault.

stories.title: ASU hockey coach is put on leave as hospitalized player remains on life support

en.title: ASU hockey coach is put on leave as hospitalized player remains on life support
en.summary: Matthew Mayich, a 21-year-old player, collapsed during a workout in extreme heat on August 20 and suffered severe heatstroke. The ASU hockey coach has been placed on leave while the player remains hospitalized.

stories.title: Gov. Hochul calls for 'independent review' of Cornell response to alleged group rape

en.title: Gov. Hochul calls for 'independent review' of Cornell response to alleged group rape
en.summary: New York Governor Hochul has requested a transparent, independent review of how Cornell University handled a student's allegations of gang rape.

stories.title: Ken Paxton heard saying Trump's GOP midterm convention hurt him: Report

en.title: Ken Paxton heard saying Trump's GOP midterm convention hurt him: Report
en.summary: Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton reportedly told fundraisers that President Trump's midterm convention negatively affected his political standing ahead of midterm elections.

stories.title: Democrats Block Stock-Trading Bill, Denying the G.O.P. a Pre-Midterm Win

en.title: Democrats Block Stock-Trading Bill, Denying the G.O.P. a Pre-Midterm Win
en.summary: Senate Democrats prevented passage of a Republican bill that would have limited congressional stock trading. The measure had been proposed as part of Republican efforts to address voter concerns.

stories.title: Senate Democrats block Husted-led bill on data centers, calling it ‘toothless’

en.title: Senate Democrats block Husted-led bill on data centers, calling it 'toothless'
en.summary: Democrats blocked a bill designed to prevent data centers from raising local utility costs, despite its lopsided House passage. Republicans characterized the Democratic action as political obstruction.

stories.title: On flight to Israel, pilot is stabbed, plane plunges before passengers tackle attacker

en.title: On flight to Israel, pilot is stabbed, plane plunges before passengers tackle attacker
en.summary: A pilot was stabbed on a flight to Israel, causing the aircraft to spin and descend. Passengers and crew members subdued the attacker and diverted the plane to land safely in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows rapid deportations to 3rd countries, agrees to hear case

en.title: Supreme Court allows rapid deportations to 3rd countries, agrees to hear case
en.summary: The Supreme Court blocked a lower court order that had prevented the Trump administration from deporting migrants to third countries without advance notification.

en.summary: Technical analysis suggests the euro could weaken further against the dollar based on daily chart patterns.

en.summary: The CEO of Solana's digital asset treasury expects China to develop a management approach for cryptocurrency, with Hong Kong serving as the primary testing ground.

en.summary: Oil prices declined slightly during early Asian trading as Middle Eastern crude exports showed signs of increasing.
